fee_notes: Initial Fee is the greater of $55,000 or $550 per guest room for new construction or conversion. In 2025, Initial Fees ranged from $25,000 to $55,000. Application Fee of $5,000 credited toward Initial Fee. Relicense Fees for transfers ranged $7,500-$55,000; for renewals $10,000-$55,000.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Fee for a new construction or conversion Chain Facility is equal to the greater of $55,000 or $550 per guest room. In 2025, our Initial Fees ranged from $25,000 to $55,000.
